title: Da-Da Miniatures
identity: Gordan Tudor, Da-Da Miniatures for tenor saxophone and piano (2007), Donemus D16432, about seven minutes. The seven-page public preview contains the title page, explanatory material, and excerpts from all three miniatures; the cover explicitly labels the score transposed.

evidence.claim: Donemus publisher metadata identifies the 2007 tenor saxophone/piano work, D16432, c. 7 minutes, and downloadable score/part products.
Visual inspection of the public preview shows three titled miniatures: I. Eine Nacht am Cafe Simplicissmus, II. Der scheue Papagei, and III. Cabaret Terbac, with excerpts from each.

score_observations.observation: Miniature I starts Impetuoso at quarter note = 126 and uses high ledger-line saxophone writing, slurs alternating with accents/staccato, sudden ff-to-pp contrasts, and dense piano figures. II begins with eight saxophone bars of rest before high sustained notes; meter changes 4/4 to 9/8 and back. III starts at quarter note = 80 and uses syncopated, rest-separated sax entries, slurred sixteenth-note runs, and piano meter changes between 4/4 and 5/4. The preview is excerpt-only; range remains unverified; the cover labels the score transposed.

review_focus: Inference from the inspected excerpts: compare articulation and register control across the miniatures, manage delayed saxophone entrances in II, and coordinate changing meters/syncopation with the piano in III.
collection_flag: Original tenor saxophone/piano collection of three miniatures; the Donemus cover explicitly labels the score transposed. Preview confirms excerpts but not audience or specific programming.

score_links.description: Seven-page public Donemus preview; cover/copyright and excerpt pages for all three pieces inspected.

gaps: The preview is excerpt-only; full written range and complete parts were not verified.
No matching saxophone performance was auditioned.
